title: city-resilience-v1 envelope (structure). plan = full city-plan-v2 validated by BUILD web/plan.js validatePlanScenario; semantics (sources of the city/category, ≤12 candidates, reserved 'base', canonical order) in resilience_contract.js

plan.description: city-plan-v2 without derived_results (derived fields are neither exported nor accepted in r9 envelopes)

cases.description: 1..7 user cases; the engine adds case 'base' (no exclusions) itself: 8 at most

id.description: BUILD rule: NFC, /^[\p{L}\p{N}_.-]+$/u, 1..64 code points (JSON Schema regex has no \p in every engine; enforced in code)

label.description: ≤120 Unicode code points, no control characters (Cc), well-formed (no lone surrogates); shown as text only

disabled_source_ids.description: IDs of SOURCE records of plan.city_id + plan.category (never candidate IDs); ≤ number of such records
